screen.mdvlcraft.abilities.none: No abilities yet. Unlock spells and techniques in your archetype skill trees.
screen.mdvlcraft.abilities.hint_pick: Click an ability, then a wheel slot. Right-click a slot to empty it.
screen.mdvlcraft.skills.hint: Click a slot, then a skill. Right-click a slot to empty it.
screen.mdvlcraft.skills.on_cooldown: That slot can be changed again in %s s
ability.mdvlcraft.dismantle.desc: Fire an invisible slash that cuts the first thing it hits.
ability.mdvlcraft.cleave.desc: Hold to carve repeatedly at a target in front of you.
ability.mdvlcraft.malevolent_shrine.desc: Cast to raise your closed domain: a black barrier dome around you. While it stands, hold the cast key on it to cut apart everything inside the dome. It drains 10 mana a second and closes when you run out; sneak and cast to close it sooner.
ability.mdvlcraft.open_malevolent_shrine: Cast to raise the shrine without a barrier. While it stands, hold the cast key on it to cut everything around it, out to 45 blocks. It drains 10 mana a second and closes when you run out; sneak and cast to close it sooner.
ability.mdvlcraft.blitz.desc: Dash forward at incredible speed and cut down whatever is in the way. No weapon needed.
ability.mdvlcraft.surprise_attack.desc: Teleport behind the creature you are looking at and strike. No weapon needed.
ability.mdvlcraft.follow_up_kick.desc: Projection sorcery: teleport to your target and kick it away. Sneak and cast to switch between the Normal and Flow forms (Flow freezes the target in a frame and shatters it).
ability.mdvlcraft.phantom_movement.desc: Projection sorcery: hold to map a path along the 24 fps rule, then release to dash it at full output, striking what you pass.
ability.mdvlcraft.myriad_blades.desc: Summon a storm of blades from the swords you carry. Cast on the ground with a sword in hand; it has its own cooldown.
ability.mdvlcraft.babylonian_armory.desc: Unleash a treasury of blades raining from the sky. Sword Soaring's art; it has its own cooldown.
ability.mdvlcraft.celestial_array.desc: Form a sword domain: each strike summons phantom blades for a while. Sword Soaring's art; it has its own cooldown.
ability.mdvlcraft.soul_hunt.desc: Launch an assault forward; kills and hits on guard-broken targets shorten its cooldown and grant buffs. Cast on the ground with a weapon in hand.
ability.mdvlcraft.boogie_woogie.desc: Clap to swap places with the creature you are looking at (10 blocks).
ability.mdvlcraft.block_clap.desc: Clap to swap places with the block you are looking at.
mdvlcraft.ponder.weapon_combo.text_1:
Press [Attack] repeatedly to chain this weapon's basic combo.
Every weapon of this type shares the moveset.
mdvlcraft.ponder.weapon_combo.text_2: Attack while sprinting to perform a [Dash Attack].
mdvlcraft.ponder.weapon_combo.text_3: Attack in mid-air to perform an [Air Attack].
mdvlcraft.ponder.weapon_ranged.text_1:
Hold [Use] to draw and aim, then release to fire.
Epic Fight aims along your view in battle mode.
ability.mdvlcraft.stance.desc: Cast to take up or drop your stance. Sneak and cast to change its element.
stance.mdvlcraft.switched: %s Stance ready (%s). Cast to take it up
mdvlcraft.ponder.rowboat_building.text_1: A rowboat is built on six watercraft frames, two wide and three long
mdvlcraft.ponder.rowboat_building.text_2: Right-click every frame with planks to give it a wood
mdvlcraft.ponder.rowboat_building.text_3: Then add three more planks to each frame until it is fully planked
mdvlcraft.ponder.rowboat_building.text_4: Place an oarlock on each middle frame, facing outwards
mdvlcraft.ponder.rowboat_building.text_5: The last piece launches the rowboat. Right-click it with two oars to row; it sails on water
mdvlcraft.ponder.sloop_building.text_1: A sloop's hull takes 24 watercraft frames: angled frames round the edge, flat frames inside
mdvlcraft.ponder.sloop_building.text_2: Right-click every frame with planks to give it a wood
mdvlcraft.ponder.sloop_building.text_3: Then add three more planks to each frame until it is fully planked
mdvlcraft.ponder.sloop_building.text_4: Place four cleats on the corner frames shown, each pair facing outwards across the hull
mdvlcraft.ponder.sloop_building.text_5: The hull becomes a sloop under construction. Look at it to see what it needs next, and right-click it with that: stripped logs for the keel, planks for the deck, more stripped logs for bowsprit, mast and boom
mdvlcraft.ponder.sloop_building.text_6: Then white wool for the mainsail and jib, fences for both railings, an anchor, and leads for the rigging
ability.mdvlcraft.gravity_stomp.desc: Stomp the ground, hitting everything around you. Also uses stamina and has its own cooldown.
ability.mdvlcraft.doppelganger.desc: Summon a double of yourself that fights at your side and repeats your attacks. Tap again while looking at an enemy to send the double behind it; hold for 2 seconds to swap places with it; sneak and cast to dismiss it.
ability.mdvlcraft.doppelganger.no_target: Look at a creature to send your double to it (hold to swap places, sneak to dismiss)
ability.mdvlcraft.doppelganger.no_room: No room for your double behind that creature
ability.mdvlcraft.doppelganger.out_of_ma: Your doppelganger fades: out of mana
ability.mdvlcraft.arcane_sustenance.desc: Turn mana into food: restores %s hunger shank and %s saturation.
ability.mdvlcraft.silent_appraisal.desc: Send out a crow that circles above you. While it lives, creatures around you glow. It drains 3 mana a second while it flies and ends when your mana runs out, the crow flies out of sight, or you sneak.
ability.mdvlcraft.blind_investment.desc: Send a crow that blinds whatever it hits.
ability.mdvlcraft.bird_strike.desc: A crow overflowing with energy dives into your target.
ability.mdvlcraft.controlled_collapse.de: Summon a flock of crows that circles for a few seconds, then dives in a barrage of bird strikes.
screen.mdvlcraft.respec.desc.choose: Reset one of your skill trees to get back every point spent in it, or change one of your classes for another.
screen.mdvlcraft.respec.desc.none: You have not picked a class yet. Pick up to two on the Classes tab of the Skills screen.
screen.mdvlcraft.respec.desc.reset: Choose the tree to reset. Every point spent in it comes back to spend again; its level stays.
screen.mdvlcraft.respec.desc.change_to: Choose the new class. It starts at Level %s (%s's Level %s, less a quarter).
screen.mdvlcraft.respec.confirm.reset: Reset the %s tree? All its skills are removed and their points come back to spend again.
screen.mdvlcraft.respec.confirm.change: Replace %s (Level %s) with %s at Level %s? All of %s's skills and its level are lost. The new tree's points are yours to spend.
message.mdvlcraft.respec.reset: %s tree reset: its points are back to spend.
message.mdvlcraft.respec.changed: %s changed to %s at Level %s: spend its points on the new tree.
ability.mdvlcraft.heavy_blow.desc: Cursed Fate's melee art: punch very hard. No weapon needed.
ability.mdvlcraft.barrage.desc: Cursed Fate's melee art: hold to throw a flurry of punches.
ability.mdvlcraft.uppercut.desc: Cursed Fate's melee art: an uppercut that throws targets into the air.
ability.mdvlcraft.follow_up_punch.desc: Cursed Fate's melee art: teleport behind the last creature you hit.
ability.mdvlcraft.leaping_crush.desc: Cursed Fate's Heavenly Restriction art: leap high and crash down on your foes. No weapon needed.
ability.mdvlcraft.focus.desc: Your next strike within 10 s (a punch, a kick or one of your arts) is a guaranteed Black Flash: 2.5x damage and a short stun.
ability.mdvlcraft.focus.ready: Focused: your next strike is a Black Flash
ability.mdvlcraft.knockout.desc: A straight punch at the creature in reach: 1.5x damage, and it blacks out, staggered like a Punishment Kick.
